locator: I q.48 a.2 co.: ad quod sequitur ea interdum deficere
interpretation: The fact on which Aquinas grounds 'in rebus malum invenitur': things that can fail from goodness sometimes do, and 'in this the nature of evil consists, that something fails from good'. Formalized in non-evaluative vocabulary (some being lacks a due perfection) so that its being evil follows only through the privation account. The argument from the perfection of the universe that explains why there are such things is not part of the reading.
